_note: Channels the collector reads, archives first (owner, 18 Nov 2026; docs/SUPPLY-CHECK.md). kind: ARCHIVE (festival or broadcaster archive: official, read first), ARTIST (a band's official channel), MIXED (official, several kinds of music: a label, a broadcaster). The collector reads ARCHIVE entries first, then ARTIST, then MIXED, keeping this file's order within each kind. id (the channel's YouTube ID, UC...) is tried first, then handle (1 unit each, the channel's name must still contain 'expect'); otherwise the collector searches YouTube for 'search' (100 units, once: the result is stored) and takes the first channel whose name contains 'expect' (accents and punctuation ignored). skipIds: channels never to use. Handles are left out until checked against the live channel (The Current: @TheCurrent, Minnesota Public Radio, confirmed by the owner 20 Nov 2026). A channel whose uploads playlist YouTube does not return (404: no public uploads, closed channel or wrong ID) is skipped with a line under skippedChannels in the run report; if it stays like that, put its ID in skipIds. Added 20 Nov 2026 (owner): official festival, broadcaster, venue and band channels found by the fan-video check. Added 26 Nov 2026 (owner: more festivals and band channels): festival, broadcaster, label and promoter channels, and band channels that already gave us official concerts but were not read in full (kept only where the full read found more: Suede HQ, Papa Roach; the dry run of 26 Nov 2026 found nothing new on Radiohead, Jimi Hendrix, The National, Scorpions, Placebo, Van Halen and Jimmy Eat World, and only online sessions on Machine Head's; the label [PIAS] gave nothing new either); entries with an id use the ID YouTube already reported for the channel (stored in our channels table), and their name is the channel's name in that table so the stored row is reused.
_artistChannels: Official channels of bands in the catalogue are added automatically by the refresh job (kind ARTIST).

discovery._note: A few YouTube searches per run (100 units each), rotating through catalogue bands. Results from fan channels are reported, never published.
